newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Borders '96 EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Borders '96 EPS view raised.

text.p: -- Robinson-Humphrey analyst David Magee said Thursday he raised his 1996 earnings estimate for Borders Group Inc to $1.33 a share from $1.30.
-- This followed the company's announcement earlier that it expects its 1996 earnings to exceed the consensus of analysts estimates of $1.29 a share.
-- Borders, a book and music retailer, typically makes all of its profits for the year in the fourth quarter, Magee said. It reported net losses for the first three quarters.
-- Earlier, Borders Group reported sales for fiscal fourth quarter-to-date rose 13.8 percent to $617.7 million.

-- The company's outlook for fourth quarter earnings above the consensus and the rise in sales for the fourth quarter to date, through January 5, pushed the stock higher. Shares at midday were up 2-1/2 at 37-1/4.
-- Magee said there is a lot of uncertainty about projections for the company's earnings because so much of its business is conducted in the fiscal fourth quarter.
"It's a big relief," he added. "They are ahead of plan and estimates are being increased."
